Yes

Package and growth perspectives, here I am in payments team so feels same payment experience team

ah so you basically moved the deck chairs around... still dealing with payments, just different flavors of the same complexity. makes sense though - flipkart payments scale is wild compared to traditional banking.

how long you been working total?

From Aug 2022
  3.5 years

3.5 years... decent runway. you've seen both sides of the payments game now.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Similar backend roles
